title: UniTime Smart AI Ingestion Schema
description: Standard JSON Schema for importing academic curriculum, course offerings, class schedules, instructors, time/room preferences, and distribution constraints into UniTime via AI ingestion pipelines.

ingestControl.description: Control metadata directing how UniTime imports and processes the payload.

mode.description: Ingestion mode. 'incremental' updates existing or appends new courses without removing unmentioned offerings. 'full_replace' synchronizes the entire subject area, removing offerings not present in the payload.

actionOnDuplicate.description: Action taken when a course offering or class section already exists in the target session.

sourceDocumentName.description: Name or identifier of the source document parsed by the AI (e.g. 'Jadwal_Kuliah_Ganjil_2024.xlsx').

extractedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp indicating when this payload was extracted by the AI engine.

validationStrictness.description: Validation policy during ingestion. 'strict' fails the batch on any unresolvable reference, 'lenient' logs warnings.

academicSession.description: Target academic session, term, and campus for the imported data.

campus.description: Campus code or location name matching UniTime session configuration.

department.description: Academic department or Program Studi managing the subject area offerings.

name.description: Official name of the department / program studi.

subjectArea.description: Subject area classification under which courses are cataloged.

abbreviation.description: Short code / prefix for the subject area (e.g. 'IF', 'CS', 'KU').

title.description: Full title of the subject area.

externalId.description: External system reference ID for synchronization with SIS / PD-Dikti.

courses.description: List of course offerings within the subject area.

distributionConstraints.description: Cross-class and inter-course distribution constraints (e.g. DIFF_TIME / CANNOT_OVERLAP, SAME_ROOM, SAME_INSTR / SAME_INSTRUCTOR, BTB / BACK_TO_BACK, MEET_WITH / MEET_TOGETHER, PRECEDENCE, AT_MOST_2_HOURS_APART).

course.description: Course offering entity containing instructional configurations and subparts.

courseNumber.description: Unique course code / number within the subject area (e.g. 'IF2110', 'CS101').

title.description: Full official course title (Nama Mata Kuliah).

projectedDemand.description: Total projected student enrollment demand for this course.

consentType.description: Special approval required for student enrollment.

scheduleBookNote.description: Public schedule book note / prerequisites displayed to students during registration.
examples: Prasyarat: IF2110 Algoritma dan Struktur Data dengan nilai minimal C

controlling.description: Indicates if this course is the controlling course in cross-listed offerings.

configurations.description: Instructional configurations breaking down course delivery methods and subparts.

courseCredit.description: Academic credit structure (SKS / Units) associated with the course.

units.description: Credit value in SKS / credit hours.

creditUnitType.description: Academic credit unit type (e.g. 'sks' for Indonesian curriculum, 'semesterHours', 'quarterHours').

minimumUnits.description: Minimum units if variable credit format is used.

maximumUnits.description: Maximum units if variable credit format is used.

durationType.description: Class duration calculation method in UniTime.

subparts.description: Instructional subparts that comprise this configuration (e.g. Lecture, Lab, Recitation).

subpart.description: An instructional subpart (e.g. Kuliah / Lecture, Lab / Praktikum, Responsi / Recitation).

minPerWeek.description: Contact minutes per week required for this subpart (e.g., 3 SKS Kuliah = 150 min, 2 SKS = 100 min, 1 SKS Lab = 100-170 min, 0 for arrange-hours / unscheduled components).

parentSubpartType.description: Reference to parent subpart type if child subpart is nested in scheduling hierarchy.

classes.description: Class sections / parallel classes instantiated under this subpart.

class.description: A specific class section offering (e.g. Kelas K01, Paralel A, Lab Section L1).

roomRatio.description: Ratio of required room size to class capacity (default 1.0; 1.2 requires room 20% larger than capacity).

scheduleNote.description: Scheduling or instructional note specific to this section.

cancelled.description: Indicates whether this class section is cancelled.

splitAttendance.description: Whether students alternate attendance across meeting days.

parentClassSection.description: Section name of the parent class section if hierarchical sectioning is used (e.g. Lab L01 tied to Lecture K01).

instructors.description: Teaching staff / instructors assigned to this class section.

timePreferences.description: Time preferences or fixed scheduled times for this class.

roomPreferences.description: Room, building, or room feature preferences for this class.

instructor.description: Instructor / Lecturer assignment for a class section.

id.description: Unique instructor identifier (NIP, NIDN, or employee ID).

name.description: Full name of the instructor, including academic degrees/titles.
examples: Dr. Eng. Ayu Pratama, S.T., M.T.
Prof. Dr. Ir. Budi Santoso, M.Sc.

email.description: Official institutional email address of the instructor.

isLead.description: True if this instructor is the lead/coordinator for the class (Koordinator Dosen Pengampu).

sharePercentage.description: Teaching load percentage share (e.g. 50 for 50:50 team teaching, or 100 for sole lecturer).

timePreference.description: Time pattern and preference level for scheduling a class.

days.description: Day pattern representation. Uses UniTime day codes ('M'=Monday, 'T'=Tuesday, 'W'=Wednesday, 'Th'/'R'=Thursday, 'F'=Friday, 'S'=Saturday, 'Su'/'U'=Sunday, 'MWF', 'TTh') or 7-digit binary mask (Mon-Sun).

startTime.description: Start time in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g. '07:00', '08:30', '13:00') or 4-digit military format ('0700').

endTime.description: End time in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g. '09:30', '11:40', '16:30') or 4-digit military format ('0930').

roomPreference.description: Location, building, room number, or room feature preference.

building.description: Building name or code (e.g. 'Labtek V', 'GK-1', 'Gedung A').

preferenceLevel.description: UniTime preference level designation. Standard verbose names ('REQUIRED', 'STRONGLY_PREFERRED', etc.) or UniTime prolog codes ('R', '-2', '-1', '0', '1', '2', 'P').

distributionConstraint.description: Distribution relationship or constraint between multiple class sections, supporting both UniTime native reference codes (e.g. DIFF_TIME, SAME_INSTR, BTB, MEET_WITH, BTB_PRECEDENCE, NHB) and canonical descriptive aliases (e.g. CANNOT_OVERLAP, SAME_INSTRUCTOR, BACK_TO_BACK, MEET_TOGETHER, PRECEDENCE, AT_MOST_2_HOURS_APART).

type.description: Constraint type reference matching UniTime native distribution codes (e.g. DIFF_TIME, SAME_INSTR, BTB, MEET_WITH, BTB_PRECEDENCE, NHB) and friendly aliases (CANNOT_OVERLAP, SAME_INSTRUCTOR, BACK_TO_BACK, MEET_TOGETHER, PRECEDENCE, AT_MOST_2_HOURS_APART).

courseNumber.description: Course code if the constraint applies strictly within one course offering scope.

classes.description: Target class sections linked by this distribution constraint.

structure.description: Constraint pair grouping structure in UniTime solver.

note.description: Human-readable explanation of why this constraint is mandated.
examples: Kuliah K01 dan K02 diajar oleh dosen yang sama sehingga jadwal tidak boleh bentrok.

classReference.description: Reference identifying a specific class section across courses and subparts.

sectionName.description: Section name of the target class (e.g. 'K01', 'L01').
